title: Aggregated endpoint (recipe)
description: One aggregated endpoint: GET /bff/<route>. Steps call service endpoints; the response template builds one answer. Always saved as a draft; a person publishes it.

id.description: Stable id: lowercase letters, digits and dashes, e.g. customer-overview.

name.description: Name people see, e.g. Customer overview.

version.description: Set by the app when saving; leave it out.

status.description: Set by the app (always draft when saved); leave it out.

method.description: HTTP method apps call it with: GET (default) or POST.

route.description: Address after /bff/, with {name} for route values, e.g. customer/{id}/overview. Each route value must be declared in inputs as route.<name>.

requireAuthentication.description: true (default): callers need a valid token.

requiredScope.description: A scope the caller's token must have, e.g. customer.read.

inputs.description: The only caller values that reach services. Keys: route.<name>, query.<name> or header.<Name>.

type.description: string, int, number, bool or date.

required.description: A request without it is refused with 400.

pattern.description: A regular expression the whole value must match, e.g. ^C-[0-9]{5}$.

default.description: Used when the caller doesn't send it.

steps.description: Service calls. They run in parallel unless one uses another's value.

alias.description: Short name used in expressions, e.g. customer (letters, digits, _). {{customer.body}} is its answer.

displayName.description: Name people see, e.g. Get customer.

endpoint.description: The service endpoint it calls: <serviceId>/<endpointId>, e.g. service-a/getCustomer.

bind.description: Values sent with the call: each moves a value (from) or a template to a target (to).

from.description: A path without braces, e.g. request.route.id, a.body.id or item; may end with | transform.

template.description: A JSON template instead of from, mainly for request bodies.

to.description: Target: path.<name>, query.<name>, header.<Name>, cookie.<name>, body or body.<field>.

default.description: Sent when the value is missing.

required.description: true (default): if it fails, the endpoint answers 502. false: a partial answer with _errors.

when.description: Run only when this is true, e.g. {{a.body.isPremium}} or {{a.body.status}} == active.

forEach.description: Run once per item of this list, e.g. {{b.body.items[*].id}}; use item in bind.

maxConcurrency.description: For forEach: calls at once (1-32, default 4).

distinct.description: For forEach: call each unique item once (default true).

timeoutMs.description: Limit for this call, in ms (default: the service's).

cache.description: Cache this call's answer. Off by default; per caller by default.

perCaller.description: true (default): each caller has their own copy. false only for data that is the same for everyone; never for customer or patient data.

combine.description: Named lists merged from several steps by exact key; used in the response as {{combine.<name>}}.

sources.description: The lists to merge, in priority order.

from.description: Path (no braces) to a list, e.g. crm.body.contacts.

key.description: Field that identifies a record, e.g. userId; several separated by commas. Matched exactly, never fuzzily.

via.description: A mapping list for services that don't share an id.

normalize.description: Applied to keys before comparing: trim, lower.

onConflict.description: priority (the first source wins) or newest:<field>.

owners.description: Field -> source name whose value always wins.

withoutKey.description: keep or drop records without a key.

response.description: The answer: any JSON with {{ }} expressions in its texts, e.g. { "customer": "{{a.body}}" }.

cache.description: Whole-answer cache. Off by default; per caller by default.

perCaller.description: true (default): each caller has their own copy. false only for data that is the same for everyone; never for customer or patient data.

timeoutMs.description: Limit for the whole call, in ms (default 10000).
